Every sample that scored 0

Failure details

The leaderboard groups these as “not a valid scene”. Here they are apart. Each MVS sample gets one outcome; everything but a valid scene scores 0, because Mol* shows nothing for it. Run 2026-10-18, 1 sample per task.

  • valid scene Mol* accepts and renders the scene; graded by tree match.
  • invalid JSON the output does not parse as JSON (the parser error is shown).
  • not an MVS tree valid JSON, but not an MVS tree (no root node).
  • invalid MVS an MVS-shaped tree that Mol*’s own validator rejects (its messages are shown).
  • failed to load passes validation but Mol* fails to load or render it.

Jump to: outcome breakdown · common messages · failing samples (spec) · failing samples (spec + dossier). Full data: failures_data.json.
